caption: The image depicts a drawing of a wooden desk with an upper hutch. The desk is composed of two main sections. The lower section features four large drawers, arranged in two rows with two drawers each, all with round dark brown knobs. The desk surface extends outward and is shown as a horizontal fold-down writing surface, covered in a green material. Above the writing surface, there are six small drawers, each also with small round knobs, and three open cubbyholes beneath them. The upper section consists of a hutch with two large glass-paned doors, divided into smaller rectangular panes, enclosing shelves inside. The overall coloring is various shades of light to medium brown, representing polished wood, with the writing surface in contrast as green. The background is a plain light beige.
title: Shaker Secretary Desk
